command:
set -eu
dir=/etc/nginx/tls
crt=$dir/server.crt
key=$dir/server.key
next_crt=$dir/server.crt.next
next_key=$dir/server.key.next
tag=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
backup_crt=$dir/server.crt.pre-rotation-$tag
backup_key=$dir/server.key.pre-rotation-$tag
test -f "$next_crt"
test -f "$next_key"
test ! -e "$backup_crt"
test ! -e "$backup_key"
cp -p "$crt" "$backup_crt"
cp -p "$key" "$backup_key"
printf '%s\n%s\n' "$backup_crt" "$backup_key" > "$dir/.rotation-backup-manifest"
activation_ok=no
if mv "$next_crt" "$crt"; then
  if mv "$next_key" "$key"; then activation_ok=yes; fi
fi
if [ "$activation_ok" != yes ]; then
  cp -p "$backup_crt" "$crt"
  cp -p "$backup_key" "$key"
  printf '%s\n' 'activation_failed_and_files_restored=yes' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! nginx -t; then
  cp -p "$backup_crt" "$crt"
  cp -p "$backup_key" "$key"
  nginx -t
  printf '%s\n' 'new_config_test_failed_and_files_restored=yes' >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf 'backup_certificate=%s\nbackup_private_key=%s\n' "$backup_crt" "$backup_key"
stat -Lc '%n owner=%U:%G mode=%a size=%s' "$crt" "$key"
printf '%s\n' 'new_files_activated_on_disk=yes nginx_config_test=passed running_workers_not_yet_reloaded=yes'
